Why am I seeing this?

This list is a record of torrents you stopped seeding before reaching a 1:1 ratio. It exists to help you keep your account in good standing — it is not a punishment.

Remove a torrent permanently

  • Seed it for 72 hours — it resets and falls off the list.
  • Continue seeding until ratio reaches 1:1.
  • Use the Clear button to pay the gap with Bonus Points or Upload Credit.
  • Become a VIP — donors are exempt entirely.

How should I seed?

  • Leave the torrent running in your client after the download completes.
  • Seed each torrent until its individual ratio is ≥ 1.
  • Prefer active torrents (ones with leechers waiting).
  • Sharing means seeding, not just downloading.
